name: Grants.gov AI Grant Matcher: score new federal grants with AI, log to Sheets & email top matches

parameters.content:
## 🏛️ Grants.gov AI Grant Matcher
Every morning this workflow pulls newly posted & forecasted federal grants from Grants.gov using the **Grants.gov Scraper** Apify actor, skips anything already logged in your Google Sheet, asks an AI model to score each new grant **0–10** against your organization profile, logs every new grant with its score and reason, and emails you a digest of the best matches (score ≥ 7). No email is sent on days without strong matches.

**Flow:** Schedule → Org profile → Read sheet → Apify run → Dedupe → AI scoring → Append to Sheet → Filter ≥7 → Gmail digest

## ⚙️ Setup (≈5 min)
1. **Apify** – install the Apify node (`@apify/n8n-nodes-apify`), add an *Apify API* credential (token from console.apify.com → Settings → Integrations).
2. **OpenAI** – add an *OpenAI* credential to the **OpenAI Chat Model** node (or swap in any chat model: Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama…).
3. **Google Sheets** – create a sheet with a tab named `Grants` and the headers below. Add a *Google Sheets OAuth2* credential and paste the sheet URL into **Read Logged Grants** and **Append to Sheet**.
4. **Gmail** – add a *Gmail OAuth2* credential and set your address in **Org Profile → digestEmail**.
5. Run once manually, then activate.

## ✏️ How to customize
- **Org Profile** (Set node): edit `orgProfile`, `keyword`, `minScore`, `digestEmail`. This is the only node most people need to touch.
- **Run Grants.gov Scraper**: change actor input — `statuses`, `agencies`, `eligibilities`, `postedWithinDays`, `maxItems`.
- **Schedule**: default 07:00 daily (cron `0 7 * * *`).
- **AI Score Grant**: tweak the prompt/rubric or the model (gpt-4o-mini is cheap and good enough).
- Swap Gmail for Slack/Teams by replacing the last node.

## 📄 Google Sheet headers (tab `Grants`, row 1)
`id | number | title | agency | status | openDate | closeDate | awardCeiling | awardFloor | estimatedTotalFunding | eligibleApplicants | categories | url | score | reason | loggedAt`

`id` is the Grants.gov opportunity ID and is used for de-duplication — don't rename it.

assignments.name: orgProfile
assignments.value: We are a US 501(c)(3) nonprofit running after-school STEM and AI-literacy programs for low-income middle and high school students in California. Annual budget ~$1.2M. Interested in education, workforce development, broadband/digital equity and community grants. Not eligible for grants restricted to universities, tribes or state agencies.

messageValues.message: You are an experienced grant writer. Score how well the grant fits the organization from 0 (no fit / ineligible) to 10 (perfect fit, clearly eligible). Penalize heavily if the organization is not an eligible applicant type. Give a one-sentence reason (max 30 words).
